summary.reason: no drift beyond the reference null on primary KPIs and no credible localized anomaly; see MDC for what could not have been detected; 1 site(s) exceed the ordinary-reference max without meeting the severity/reliability conditions (expected on ~40 % of clean batches)
summary.what_would_move_it: would become 'investigate — drift' if bright_d50 (Holm p = 0.36, shift +1.4 MAD) crossed α = 0.05 with |shift| ≥ 1.0 MAD; would become 'investigate — localized' if a site exceeded the ordinary-reference max by ≥ 3.0 MAD on crack_frac or pore_max_d, or ≥ 2 sites / both KPIs by ≥ 2.0 MAD (a single site between the two margins is routed to image review without changing the verdict)

escalation.rule: single site ≥ 3.0 MAD, or ≥ 2 sites / ≥ 2 KPIs pending at ≥ 2.0 MAD, or a confirmed review

descriptive_flags.note: batch-mean KPI: outlying site, not a localized defect (see per-site drift)

acquisition.note: sensitivity analysis: attenuation is the share by which the energy statistic drops under the stratified / adjusted view; it is not a share of the shift caused by the instrument

crack_frac.statement: Crack-like void area fraction is higher than the reference (robust shift 0.1 MAD) → more delamination-like void area in the section, direction only.
crack_frac.note: ±5-level threshold band not available for this KPI/these sites; statement printed ungated

pore_max_d.statement: Largest void (2-D equivalent diameter) is higher than the reference (robust shift 0.0 MAD) → a larger largest void; localized-defect path to be checked, direction only.
pore_max_d.note: ±5-level threshold band not available for this KPI/these sites; statement printed ungated

pore_frac.statement: Macro-pore area fraction is lower than the reference (robust shift 0.1 MAD) → less segmented 2-D void area; packing/wetting implications need independent validation, direction only.
pore_frac.note: ±5-level band half-width (median of 24 sites with a band, analysis_cache/acquisition_sites.csv (acquisition.threshold_bands; relative band × site fraction)) = 0.0165; |Δ median| = 0.0010 → physics reading withheld (shift inside the band)

bright_frac.statement: Bright-phase (additive) area fraction is higher than the reference (robust shift 0.8 MAD) → more observed additive area; recipe, utilization and mechanical implications need validation, direction only.
bright_frac.note: ±5-level band half-width (median of 24 sites with a band, analysis_cache/acquisition_sites.csv (acquisition.threshold_bands; relative band × site fraction)) = 0.0032; |Δ median| = 0.0069 → physics reading printed

bright_d50.statement: Bright-phase area-weighted D50 is higher than the reference (robust shift 1.4 MAD) → coarser additive sections; contact, chemistry and electrolyte access also affect later reaction/mechanics, direction only.
bright_d50.note: ±5-level threshold band not available for this KPI/these sites; statement printed ungated

physics.fraction_connected_note: No 2-D top-to-bottom macro-pore path on any of the 24 sites of this pair (fraction_connected = 0); the section tortuosity index is undefined and is not reported.
